lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: So he said he got angry?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Did he say how he did it?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: What exactly did he say? He said he, you saw the bones and you said to him why did you do it? Or did you ask him if it was a body or how did that go?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: OK and he said exactly what?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Did he tell you where he did it?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: What did he tell you about the truck?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: You saw her car didn't ya? Her RAV4. Where was it when you saw it?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: On the other side of the street ...

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: Where did you see it later? Was it in his garage later? Did you see it in his garage?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: When was the first time you went out again?
